title: smyrnium idaeum
intro: Smyrnium idaeum, commonly known as the Cretan carrot or sea holly, is a plant species in the family Apiaceae. This plant is known for its edible roots and has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits. The health benefits of Smyrnium idaeum include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antibacterial properties, which may help to protect against oxidative stress, reduce inflammation, and prevent infections. The bioactive constituents of Smyrnium idaeum include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which may exhibit therapeutic actions such as analgesic, anti-cancer, and hepatoprotective effects.
